## Members in this source section

TextAlign, TextBaseline, TextDirection, TextOverflow, ParagraphStyle, TextRun, TextLayout

## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Horizontal placement of lines within a paragraph's width. Start is left in
// left-to-right text and right in right-to-left; End is the opposite.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Typographic_alignment)
type TextAlign = Left | Center | Right | Justify | Start | End;

// The vertical reference line text is positioned by.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baseline_(typography))
type TextBaseline = Alphabetic | Top | Hanging | Middle | Ideographic | Bottom;

// The primary reading direction of a paragraph.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bidirectional_text)
type TextDirection = LeftToRight | RightToLeft;

// What happens to text that exceeds its layout constraints; Visible text is
// drawn beyond the bounds.
type TextOverflow = Clip | Ellipsis | Fade | Visible;

// Paragraph-level styling. LineHeight is a multiplier applied on top of each
// run's own line height (1.0 is neutral). FirstLineIndent and
// ParagraphSpacing are in document units.
type ParagraphStyle
    implements IValue
{
    Align: TextAlign;
    Direction: TextDirection;
    LineHeight: Number;
    FirstLineIndent: Number;
    ParagraphSpacing: Number;
}

// A maximal stretch of text sharing one style; rich text is a sequence of
// runs.
type TextRun
    implements IValue
{
    Text: String;
    Style: TextStyle;
}

// The input to text layout: styled runs, paragraph settings, and wrapping
// constraints. MaxWidth is in document units; a negative value means
// unconstrained. MaxLineCount of -1 means unlimited. Overflow applies when
// either constraint is exceeded. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wrapping_(text))
type TextLayout
    implements IValue
{
    Runs: Array<TextRun>;
    Paragraph: ParagraphStyle;
    MaxWidth: Number;
    MaxLineCount: Integer;
    Overflow: TextOverflow;
}
```
